methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective single-center real-world study of 104 Chinese ABC patients (63 HER2-positive, 41 HER2-low) receiving T-DXd. Clear inclusion/exclusion criteria, consistent T-DXd dosing (5.4 mg/kg q21d), RECIST 1.1 assessment, NCI-CTCAE 5.0 AE grading, enhanced ILD/cardiac monitoring. Multivariate Cox regression used stepwise selection with HER2 status, HR status, and prior treatment lines adjusted. However, follow-up is short (median 8.57 months) with only 34.6% events, making mPFS estimates immature and unstable particularly in HER2-low subgroup. No prospective design, no external validation, and data cutoff leaves 65.4% of patients still on treatment. Authors acknowledge short follow-up, no OS data, and small sample for AE detection.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Individual cohort study of an approved drug in a real-world Chinese population, consistent with Oxford LoE 2b. Findings are directly clinically relevant: confirming T-DXd efficacy in Chinese ABC patients broadly aligned with DB-03/DB-04/DAISY trials, identifying earlier treatment lines as associated with longer mPFS (16.3 vs 11.4 months, p=0.013), and reporting manageable safety (low ILD incidence 1.9%). Supports routine use and informs sequencing decisions in Chinese practice.

reporting_quality.justification: STROBE is the applicable standard for observational cohorts. Eligibility, endpoints, safety monitoring, and statistical methods are described; figures and tables are listed with appropriate legends. However, STROBE adherence is not declared, no data/code availability statement is provided, PFS confidence intervals are reported but some values (e.g., HER2-positive 95% CI 11.115-17.225) are given with excessive decimal precision that suggests raw output without rounding. The Safety section has a mid-sentence typo ('varying severity. of varying severity').

novelty_literature.justification: The study is explicitly a real-world validation in a Chinese single-center cohort (n=104) of T-DXd efficacy and safety established in DB-02, DB-03, DB-04, DB-06, and DAISY trials, plus a prior Chinese multicenter real-world study (ref 21, Sang et al.). The incremental contribution is relatively modest: confirming efficacy ordering (HER2-positive > HER2-low) and identifying treatment-line as an independent predictor in a Chinese population. Novelty is incremental confirmation with limited mechanistic or methodological advance.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is generally readable with standard IMRaD structure. However, several stylistic/grammatical problems exist: mid-sentence duplication ('varying severity. of varying severity'), run-on sentences in Introduction, and occasional awkward phrasing ('Aged >= 18 years; Pathologically confirmed...'). Discussion is proportionate and contextualizes against pivotal trials. Tables and figures are referenced but cannot be evaluated directly.

key_strengths: Real-world Chinese cohort (n=104) evaluating T-DXd across HER2-positive and HER2-low subgroups, with enhanced ILD/cardiac safety monitoring
Multivariate Cox adjustment identifying HER2 status, ECOG PS, and prior treatment lines as independent predictors of PFS
Reasonable comparison against DB-03 and DB-04 baseline characteristics to contextualize real-world vs trial differences
Low ILD incidence (1.9%, both Grade I) consistent with pivotal trial data, adding real-world safety evidence
key_concerns: Immature data: median follow-up 8.57 months, only 34.6% progression/death events, 65.4% of patients still on treatment — mPFS estimates are unstable especially for HER2-positive subgroup where median was not reached in many similar cohorts
No OS analysis because of short follow-up (acknowledged)
Largely confirmatory of DB-03/DB-04/DAISY and a prior Chinese multicenter real-world study — limited incremental value
Typographical errors ('varying severity. of varying severity'), inconsistent decimal precision in CIs, no STROBE/data-availability disclosure
HER2-low subgroup small (n=41) and had higher HR-positive and >3 prior lines proportion, creating confounding that the authors address but cannot fully resolve
chief_reviewer.rationale: A competent but confirmatory single-center Chinese real-world study with immature follow-up and largely replicating existing pivotal trial and prior real-world findings; best fits a tier 3 specialty journal after major revisions to improve follow-up maturity, correct typographical errors, and add STROBE/data-availability disclosures.
